versions.changelog:
- Added _meta.json file for metadata management.
- No changes to functionality or documentation content.

- Initial release of english-dict, an English dictionary lookup tool with Chinese definitions.
- Provides phonetics, part of speech, and two auto-generated example sentences for queried words.
- Supports command line queries for basic English vocabulary.
- Includes a small built-in word list; users can expand it or connect to external dictionary APIs (Youdao, Oxford).
- Offers detailed setup instructions and usage examples in SKILL.md.
